findings.text: follow-on: the corpus cache is never pruned, so an entry for every content a file ever had is written on and never evicted, and corpus.json grows without bound across the revisions and worktrees that share the cache root.

follow-on: head_functions is typed list[Any] and _index declares Iterable[_Function] while it now also receives _CachedFunction, so the type checker cannot catch an interface mismatch between the two window providers.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 57dfae0345; 76c09104 adds the digest-keyed cache (+294/-2) and 6e7c645a makes the cache write best-effort and adds the two regression tests (+48/-1), all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when asks for a bounded-scan-equals-full-scan test on a synthetic repository plus a negative control; tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py:85 asserts the warm scan equals the cold scan, :98 counts parses, :135 forces the on-disk round trip, :155 asserts an unwritable cache still reports, and both negative controls are EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a promotion's clone scan fingerprints only what the promoted diff touches or reuses cached fingerprints; reckon/clones.py:334 parses a changed file from its head bytes and clones.py:342 serves every other corpus file under the prefixes from a digest-keyed cache, and clone-profile/head-warm.json records functions_in at 1 call against 868 cold.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records head 6e7c645a with 13 passed against a 7-passed base, two negative controls, and the cold/warm profile pair.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is reckon/clones.py, tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py, the evidence fragment and the figures dir; both landed commits touch exactly the first two and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: negative-control-b reddens test_an_unwritable_cache_directory_still_reports_matches (:155) and negative-control-a reddens test_the_disk_cache_round_trips... (tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py:135), both green at head.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py:85 asserts the warm scan equals the cold scan, :135 forces the disk round trip and :155 the unwritable cache, and head-clones.log records 13 passed EXIT=0 with both negative controls EXIT=1; docked because clone-profile/head-cold.json still puts the clone scan at 0.61 of wall time (42.60/69.35 s, above the 0.49 baseline), so the win holds only with a warm cache.
justifications.fit: _CachedFunction at clones.py:155 mirrors the frozen _Function dataclass, but clones.py:327 annotates head_functions as list[Any] and _index still declares Iterable[_Function] while now receiving _CachedFunction.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/clones.py:334 parses only the changed file and clones.py:342 reads the rest from the digest cache, and clone-profile/head-warm.json records functions_in at 1 call (0.002 s) against 868 cold calls.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two landed commits touch only reckon/clones.py and tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py, both declared write paths.
